title: Man run over by police dies
article: A man who was run over by a police van while allegedly fleeing a crime scene on a bicycle died last night at Ottawa Hospital.
Benoit Aube, 38, who had been at the General campus intensive care unit since early Friday morning, died about 10 p.m., said nursing co-ordinator Sheila Moffat.
Mr. Aube was run over on Clarence Street near Cumberland Street.

At about 1:20 a.m. Friday, several police vehicles responded to a theft in progress, including a tactical unit van, where a chase started between Mr. Aube and his friend, Eric Albert, 33, on bicycles and the officers in vehicles.

What happened during the chase is the subject of a Special Investigations Unit probe, but the result was Mr. Aube was hit and pinned under the front left wheel of the van while Mr. Albert was arrested.
Witnesses say Mr. Aube, who had a head injury, was trapped for up to 30 minutes and was bleeding heavily.
While Mr. Aube's clung to life yesterday, Mr. Albert made a brief appearance in court.
He is charged with possession of burglary tools, attempting commit a crime and breaching probation.
His case was adjourned until Tuesday.
